_snapshotData.name: Revvity, Inc.
_snapshotData.description: Revvity, Inc. provides health sciences solutions, technologies, and services. The company offers instruments, reagents, software, subscriptions, detection and imaging technologies, extended warranties, and training and services; and instruments, reagents, and assay platforms and software products for early detection of common and rare conditions, such as pregnancy and early childhood, as well as infectious disease testing in the diagnostics market. Its products are used for testing and screening genetic abnormalities, disorders, and diseases, including down syndrome, hypothyroidism, muscular dystrophy, infertility, and various metabolic conditions. It also develops technologies that enable and support genomic workflows using protein coupled receptors and next-generation DNA sequencing for oncology, immunodiagnostics, and drug discovery. It serves pharmaceutical and biotechnology companies, laboratories, academic and research institutions, public health authorities, private healthcare organizations, doctors, and government agencies under the AutoDELFIA, chemagic, Chitas, CNGnome, DELFIA, DELFIA Xpress, EONIS, EUROArray, EUROIMMUN, EUROLabWorkstation, EUROLINE, EUROPattern, Evolution Evoya, GSP, Haoyuan, IDS Immunodiagnosticsystems, IDS-i10, IDS-i10T, IDS-i20, IDS-iSYS, iLab, iQ, LifeCycle, LimsLink, Migele, NeoBase, NeoLSD, NEXTFLEX, Panthera Puncher, PreNAT II, Prime, RONIA, SimplicityChrom, Specimen Gate, Superflex, Symbio, T-SPOT, Vanadis, ViaCord, VICTOR2, and WholePanel brand names, as well as under the Accell, AlphaLISA, AlphaPlex, AlphaScreen, Alpha SureFire, AssayMate, BIOCHIPs, BioLegend, Bioo Scientific, BioQule, Brilliant Violet, Ce3D, CellCarrier, Cellaca, Celigo, Cellometer, cell::explorer, Cell-Vive, Chalice, ChemDraw, CHOSOURCE, Dharmacon, and DharmaFECT brand names. The company was formerly known as PerkinElmer, Inc. and changed its name to Revvity, Inc. in April 2023. Revvity, Inc. was founded in 1937 and is headquartered in Waltham, Massachusetts.

moatAnalysis.moat_narrative: Revvity, Inc. possesses a narrow economic moat (score: 51/100). Strongest advantages: Supply-Side Economies (moderate) and Learning Curve (moderate). Revvity, Inc.

supply_side.explanation: Revvity, Inc. shows moderate supply-side economies of scale. Revenue growing at 4.3% with earnings growing at 37.8% — positive 33.5% operating leverage. strong gross margins of 55.9% and operating margins of 17.1% at at current scale.

network_effects.explanation: Revvity, Inc. has limited demand-side economies of scale. Diagnostics & Research suggests limited network potential. Financial trends do not strongly indicate network effects. Awaiting user product-level assessment.

learning_curve.explanation: Revvity, Inc. has moderate learning curve advantages. In Diagnostics & Research, cumulative R&D creates knowledge barriers new entrants cannot replicate. Historical margin data confirms sustained high margins.

switching_costs.explanation: Revvity, Inc. benefits from moderate switching costs. Diagnostics & Research creates structural switching costs — established business relationships create meaningful switching friction. 56% gross margins suggest customers pay premium rather than switch. YoY revenue growth of 4.3% indicates strong customer retention.

aiDisruption.threat_analysis: AI presents manageable disruption to Diagnostics & Research. Some processes will be automated, but core value chain has structural resistance.
aiDisruption.opportunity_analysis: AI offers meaningful opportunities for Revvity, Inc. to enhance operations, accelerate R&D, and develop AI-enhanced premium products.
aiDisruption.net_assessment: Revvity, Inc. faces a neutral from AI. AI creates both challenges and opportunities that roughly balance.
